'''John Sydney Oxford''' (born 6 March 1942) is an English [[virologist]] and a professor at [[Queen Mary, University of London]]. He is a leading expert on [[influenza]], including [[Avian influenza|bird flu]] and the [[1918 flu pandemic|1918 Spanish Influenza]], and [[HIV/AIDS]].

==Education==
Oxford was educated at the [[University of Reading]], gaining a [[Bachelor of Science]] degree in 1963 and the [[University of Sheffield]] where he was awarded a  [[PhD]] in 1966.<ref name="whoswho"/>

==Research==
Oxford is noted for his work with  Retroscreen Virology, a virology research company which he established in 1989 with EU funding.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://ec.europa.eu/research/profiles/index_en.cfm?p=1_oxford |title=Professor John Oxford |publisher=Ec.europa.eu |access-date=30 May 2013 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081226211442/http://ec.europa.eu/research/profiles/index_en.cfm?p=1_oxford |archive-date=26 December 2008 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal | last1 = Welliver | first1 = R. | last2 = Monto | first2 = A.
